hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; if [[ "$f" == *"index.html" ]]; then cp "$f" "${f}.backup.$(date +%s)" && echo '{"statusMessage": "Backed up index.html"}'; fi; }

jq -r '.tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; if [[ "$f" == *"index.html" ]]; then current=$(grep -oP '(?<=content=")[0-9.]+' "$f" | head -1) && if [[ $current =~ ^([0-9]+)\.([0-9]+)\.([0-9]+)$ ]]; then major="${BASH_REMATCH[1]}"; minor="${BASH_REMATCH[2]}"; patch="${BASH_REMATCH[3]}"; patch=$((patch + 1)); new_version="$major.$minor.$patch"; sed -i "s/content=\"$current\"/content=\"$new_version\"/" "$f" && echo "{\"statusMessage\": \"Version bumped: $current → $new_version\"}"; fi; fi; }
